transitive_runtime.execution_mode: verified /usr/bin/python3.12 via held fd with -X pycache_prefix=/dev/null -B -I -S and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1; privileged repair script is stdlib-only

scientific_dependencies.required_authenticated_evidence: exact signed stage queue/approval, exact completed contract/preflight/ledger/queue bundle, approval-bound child ledger HMAC, delivered terminal notification, and consumed approval

parent_failures.failure: EXDEV before any source artifact mutation

implementation.method: same-filesystem quarantine plus cross-filesystem copy, fsync, hash/decode verification, and atomic replacement
implementation.fault_injection_environment: disabled in production; isolated tests use an in-process fixture hook that is never inherited by the repair child

authorization.approval_record: HMAC-authenticated exact_operator_approval bound to this experiment/run, preregistration, HARN executable, and immutable queue-entry descriptor
authorization.queue: HMAC-authenticated queue and approval transitions under the dedicated queue mutation lock
authorization.write_capability: one-use HMAC capability for apply/rollback/reconcile bound to exact approval record/state, action, archived executable bytes, parent PID/start/boot identity, held HARN lock, and freshly rehashed immutable bindings
authorization.approval_lifecycle: approved -> reserved -> consumed; same-run reservation is recoverable after controller crash while consumed or rejected approval fails closed
authorization.environment: PATH is fixed to the preregistered system path and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 is forced; LD_LIBRARY_PATH, PYTHONPATH, PYTHONHOME, MEANAUDIO_REPAIR2_FAIL_AFTER_PHASE, MEANAUDIO_REPAIR2_CAPABILITY, MEANAUDIO_REPAIR2_APPROVAL_SHA256, and MEANAUDIO_NOTIFY_DRY_RUN are not inherited
authorization.fd_execution: Repair executable, child controller, and explicitly bound imported shared HARN module are opened with O_NOFOLLOW, hashed from the held descriptor, and executed/imported through inherited /proc/self/fd descriptors
authorization.terminal_authentication: terminal child bundles require both exact raw-hash edges and a valid child-ledger HMAC chain under the exact approval-bound private-key descriptor
authorization.unresolved_AUTH_ROOT: Local HMAC authenticates integrity only against processes that cannot read the private key. A malicious same-UID process or external signer with key access remains able to forge queue, approval, or child-ledger authentication; OS-level uid/service isolation or an external asymmetric signer is required to close AUTH-ROOT.

dual_authority_recovery.lock_lease: top_controller -> queue_mutation -> stage_controller -> repair2_controller -> continuation_controller; every guarded action holds verified O_NOFOLLOW LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB FDs; nested actions reuse the lease and top-spawned children receive pass_fds duplicates of the same open-file descriptions, so there is no lock-order inversion or child self-deadlock

implementation.crash_recovery: A recognized transaction state is reconciled and persisted as held; the same run and exact approval resume without repeating audit or terminalizing the recoverable child crash.

mutation_envelope.rollback_action: restore the original target and metrics from their same-filesystem quarantines
